concerns.text: FR-002 mandates applying censored data methods (e.g., Tobit regression) for paired effect-size analysis when inequalities are present. Tasks T023 and T024 only implement standard paired t-tests/Wilcoxon tests which cannot handle interval-censored data. A specific task to implement or integrate a censored regression model is missing.

FR-002 requires excluding p-value inequalities from p-curve analysis. Task T021 (p-curve analysis) does not explicitly include a data-filtering step to remove these entries before analysis, risking the inclusion of noise forbidden by the spec.

FR-004 requires comparing the *results* of p-curve analyses (e.g., estimated power or p-hacking prevalence) between venues. Tasks T021 and T022 focus on histograms and density ratios but lack a task to calculate and compare the specific p-curve derived metrics required by the spec.

Task T014 describes filtering logic for 'methodological shift' and 'unmatched' pairs but does not explicitly include the requirement to log these exclusion reasons in a structured format (e.g., dedicated log file or metadata column) as implied by the spec's edge case handling for auditability.
